answer: A bond of 23% of expected earnings must sit in a custody account that the identity cannot spend from, only forfeit. Deposits are visible in summit, and crystal reconciles the forfeits at each close. Because the custody account is separate, anyone cannot recycle one pool of capital across 32 aliases, and each one needs its own funded opal account. The honest user pays this once; a farm pays it 44 times over for the same share of the pool. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
